messages:
sam: quick heads-up — i'm planning a small schema shim for streaming deltas: add an optional `metadata` object on message/tool_call events so we can attach lightweight provenance tags (source, model_snapshot, trace_id). this should be fully optional and ignored by older clients.

maria: curious for semantics — will `metadata` live next to `content` or inside `tool_call` payload? any examples? will this affect reassembly?

sam: proposal: top-level on the message object, e.g. `message.metadata = { source: \"ingest\", model: \"redwood/v1.2\" }`. not touching `tool_call` internals to avoid changing function arg shapes. reassembly unchanged — parser should ignore unknown top-level fields.

cj: small concern: some SDKs do strict JSON schema validation for messages. if we add unknown keys clients will 400 during validation. options: 1) bump stream proto minor and add preamble header so SDKs can detect compat; 2) namespace field under `x_*` so validators skip it; 3) add `message_type` enum to make ignoring explicit.

sam: leaning toward option 1: add a small preamble JSON frame at stream start indicating `proto_minor` and enabled flags. older SDKs will see lower proto and keep previous behavior. example preamble: 

```json
{ "stream_preamble": { "proto_minor": 3, "flags": ["message-metadata"] } }
```

this keeps message objects freeform.

olivia: code-review ping — @cj @maria can you review the PR when it's up? main place of risk is the runtime stream parser and sdk consumer that do early validation. also need docs for backcompat.

cj: ok. for SDKs we should provide a tiny helper in the streaming client to drop unknown fields automatically (opt-out with a strict flag). i'll add that to the SDK PR.

maria: also add a sentence in the API contract: unknown top-level fields on messages MUST be ignored by clients unless they explicitly opt into strict mode. keeps expectations clear.

sam: agreed — i'll add that line to the contract doc and include a changelog entry. one more thing: ensure `metadata` size limit (e.g., 1KB) — no blobs. security ok? tagging @security in doc.

olivia: deploy-bot shows canary enabled on staging: `shim_metadata` feature-flag. please run integration tests against streaming reassembly before we flip.

deploy-bot: FYI: staging runtime v2.8.1 (canary) has flag `shim_metadata=true` on 2/3 hosts.

cj: action items summary: 1) sam rename field to `metadata` and add proto preamble frame + contract note; 2) sam add schema tests for parser ignoring unknown fields; 3) cj add SDK helper (dropUnknownFields) + docs; 4) olivia run reassembly integration with canary; 5) maria add changelog and security note. target: EOD Wed for initial PR.

sam: thanks — PR incoming in ~1h. if no objections by EOD we'll merge behind feature flag and coordinate the SDK patch next sprint. :thumbsup:
